reuse.why: The change reuses the existing month-fill predicate, category selector, amount conversion, tag parser, and undoable handler registration.

duplication.why: Eligibility and amount-sign decisions remain shared, although action argument types and several test assertion blocks repeat.

placement.why: Budget eligibility stays in actions.ts, tag parsing uses the shared tags module, and method registration stays in app.ts.

scope.why: All edits directly support the requested month-wide exclusions, spending action, optional visibility flag, and associated tests.

maintainability.why: The shared predicate keeps policy changes centralized, with minor maintenance overhead from repeated argument types and duplicated visibility guard calls.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All affected month-wide actions use isMonthFillCategory directly or through getMonthFillCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: Repeated test assertions and argument declarations are explicit; eligibility and amount conversion are shared rather than reshaped into local copies.

abstraction_drift.where: isMonthFillCategory and getMonthFillCategories each gain includeHiddenCategories; the predicate adds template, fixed-group, and two unknown-visibility guards, while every month-wide caller continues through it.
